problem: Native Word WPS/WPG drawing branches were discarded by the common document visibility profile. Merely enabling them let group-child geometry/text overwrite the outer flat inventory entry, and text-box paragraphs were concatenated without boundaries.
changes: Declare WPS/WPG owner namespaces in the shared eager/source-backed document visibility profile, exposing supported DrawingML branches once while retaining original package XML and VML fallbacks.

Retain a group root as one Other inventory entry with its own properties. Skip direct child graphics with bounded nesting; nested drawing stories cannot replace an outer anchor. Prefer wp:extent frame dimensions over DrawingML transform extents.
Decode text-box text references and CDATA and retain whitespace, paragraph boundaries, tabs and breaks. Reject truncated or excessively deep drawing XML; remove an obsolete Clippy expectation.
Add one native cross-owner drawing regression and three unit regressions; strengthen the existing native text-box and operations tests, and reconcile their index/current matrix scopes.

verification_scope.native_visuals: Eager and pinned source-backed views expose Picture 1, Rounded Rectangle 3, Picture 2 and Chart 4 in order. The rounded rectangle is a floating WPS TextBox with RoundRect preset, 2984500x939800 frame and exact two-paragraph text. The text-box reader exposes native ID 1925752799 rather than the formerly selected VML anchor.
verification_scope.native_vector: Both owner routes expose Graphic 1, Graphic 3 and Diagram 2 in order. Graphic 3 is one inline Other entry with 3048000x1714500 frame, no child preset and no flattened child text. Group-child semantics are not invented.
verification_scope.groups_and_nested_drawings: Synthetic group root offset 50/60 and outer frame survive conflicting child offset 12/34, child extents/preset/text and group transform extents. A nested drawing in a text-box story cannot overwrite the outer name/extent. Truncated/deep group descendants fail rather than returning an empty success.
verification_scope.text: Text-box inventory preserves literal leading/trailing spaces, an ampersand, numeric Unicode reference, tab, explicit line break, CDATA, empty paragraph and later paragraph in exact source order. Frame dimensions remain distinct from transform offsets and extents.
verification_scope.operations: Existing Auto/eager SmartArt native-node edit and explicit process-layout rebuild now also assert that all three drawing anchors and the converted group frame remain readable after save/reopen. Existing exact group XML, unrelated parts and inverse/source checks remain in force.
verification_scope.validation: Complete DOCX owner, affected DOCX operations and eight-format facade pass after the profile/parser changes. Final owner/operations/facade reruns include the stronger group-own-transform distinction. Clippy, targeted formatting, 72 Python tests, corpus integrity and CI configuration verification pass.
verification_scope.environment: Original native fixtures and all three pre-existing untracked files remain unchanged. No native Office reopen, rendering, external refresh, host layout, macro/control activation or group-child authoring occurred.
